📖 How to use

  1. Enter the file size and choose its unit (B, KB, MB, GB, TB).

  4. Compare seconds, minutes and hours totals for planning.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Why is my download slower than my plan's speed?

Advertised speeds are in megabits per second (Mbps); file sizes are in megabytes (MB). Divide by 8 to convert: 100 Mbps ≈ 12.5 MB/s before overhead.

Does it use 1000 or 1024 for KB/MB?

Decimal (SI): 1 KB = 1,000 bytes, 1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes, matching how ISPs and drive makers quote figures.

What about protocol overhead?

Real transfers lose ~5–10% to TCP/IP and protocol overhead, so add a margin to the theoretical time shown.
